mines.mine_notes: Gold-copper concentrate producer. 2025: 2,181,462 t processed @ 3.04 g/t Au, 0.75% Cu; recoveries Au 81.9%, Cu 83.3%; gold in conc 174,434 oz; payable gold sold 150,524 oz; payable copper sold 24,834 Klbs. Cash cost and AISC are net of by-product credits, per oz of gold sold. Feb 2026 updated reserve estimate extends mine life to 2036 (~160,000 GEO/yr LOM plan).
mines.processing: Flotation to gold-copper concentrate and pyrite concentrate

mines.mine_notes: Open pit gold mine nearing end of life. 2025: 796,675 t processed @ 3.45 g/t Au, recovery 79.7%; gold in conc 70,545 oz; payable gold sold 68,515 oz. Reserve figure per 2024 AIF (2025 AIF not publicly accessible).

Acquired Sept 3, 2025 via Adriatic Metals plc acquisition. Silver-lead-zinc-gold underground mine, pre-commercial; commercial production expected end 2026. Post-acquisition (Sept 3-Dec 31, 2025): 78,918 t processed @ 230.54 g/t Ag, 7.82% Zn, 5.45% Pb, 3.03 g/t Au, 0.67% Cu; recoveries Ag 94.7%, Zn 89.2%, Pb 93.5%, Au 79.1%, Cu 95.3%; metals in conc: 533,376 oz Ag, 11,857 Klbs Zn, 8,599 Klbs Pb, 5,920 oz Au, 1,071 Klbs Cu. Not included in consolidated 2025 operating highlights.
mines.processing: Flotation to lead-silver and zinc concentrates

mines.mine_notes: Development project. Feasibility study (Nov 2025): 10-year mine life; ~189,000 oz/yr gold in first five years; LOM avg AISC $644/oz gold; initial capex ~$448M; first concentrate production anticipated H1 2029; construction expected early 2027 (permitting in progress). FS figures per feasibility study; not yet in production.

notes: Renamed from Dundee Precious Metals Inc. to DPM Metals Inc. effective Sept 12, 2025. FY2025 Q4 MD&A + financial statements composite used. 2025: total 250,899 oz gold in concentrates produced (Chelopech 174,434 + Ada Tepe 70,545 + Vares 5,920); 29,995 Klbs copper in conc. Chelopech reserve update (Feb 5, 2026 news release, reflecting year-end 2025): P&P 1.6 Moz Au, 308 Mlbs Cu. Ada Tepe reserve per 2024 AIF (0.138 Moz) since 2025 AIF not publicly accessible; mine approaching end of life. Vares reserves effective April 1, 2025. Vares 2025 revenue $93.7M and net earnings $28.0M post-acquisition (pre-commercial). Also holds Loma Larga (Ecuador) and Timok (Serbia) reserves not recorded here.
